# Akvora

> Akvora is a technology solutions company delivering full-stack development, AI integration, cloud deployment, and technical education (webinars, seminars, and career guidance).

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://akvora.in/): Overview of Akvora, services, leadership, and contact.
- [About Us](https://akvora.in/about): Company mission, values, and digital transformation focus.
- [Services](https://akvora.in/services): Full-Stack Development, AI Integration, Deployment & Cloud, and Webinars, Seminars & Career Guidance.
- [Founders](https://akvora.in/founders): Meet the founders of Akvora — Aravind K. and Karthik K.
- [Aravind K. — Founder & CEO](https://akvora.in/founders/aravind-k): Detailed profile of Aravind K., AI researcher and solutions engineer.
- [Karthik K. — Founder & CTO](https://akvora.in/founders/karthik-k): Detailed profile of Karthik K., full-stack architect.
- [CEO Leadership](https://akvora.in/ceo): Leadership overview for CEO Aravind K.
- [Contact](https://akvora.in/contact): Project inquiry form and direct contact channels.
